interventions.detail: Installed zstd, required by Ollama install.sh to extract the release archive
No systemd in container: started 'ollama serve' manually (nohup) before pull and for serving
Set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' and OLLAMA_LLM_LIBRARY=cpu to run on CPU only
run.sh preloads the model with keep_alive so the first chat request answers quickly
